notes.title: 1.11.7 Quality of life update!
notes.content:
[b]Happy 2023 everyone[/b], Its been awhile since an update has been posted. Development slowed over the winter months, The new level coming out (Level 20) got delayed repeatedly & sadly won't be apart of this update either. although theirs a bright side, a few new features are in the making along with level twenty.  A beta branch has been created to showcase the new approaches & features, updates for this branch will be frequent though not perfect. Check it out if your interested, aside from that 1.11.7 Quality of life update addresses a few audio issues, adjustments to the Main Menu & Texture fixes. 2023 has alot in store for StarBallMadNess, stay tuned as always happy gaming.

-------------------------
[u][b]ChangeLog[/b][/u]
-------------------------
[olist]
[*] Fixed audio for StarCoin pickup.
[*] Adjusted MainMenu button positions.
[*] Patched a global motor issue on level sixteen.
[*] Adjusted a spawner in level nineteen.
[*] Various lighting tweaks across multiple levels.
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.9.2 is here!
notes.content:
1.9.2 is a relatively minor update various tweaks, adjustments & fixes have been made. Theirs a good chance StarBallMadNess is going to undergo some fairly big changes soon, its become apparent that some of the levels are just to hard. The plan so far is to change the order of the levels, as well as for the next few maps pull back on the difficulty a considerable amount. A changelog will now be on the bottom. Thank you for playing happy gaming :)

-------------
Changelog
-------------
-On every level the music volume has been adjusted, so its not so bloody loud 

-First level, Eleventh level, Seventeenth level, have changed slightly to make the level a bit easier

-Eleventh level now has improved lighting perhaps it was to dark

-Sixteenth level had a slight bug that told the player that the level they'd just finished was the last one then proceeding to still load the player to the next level

notes.title: Update 1.9.1 Level adjustments and minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Update 1.9.1 brings forth some much needed adjustments to eight of the levels. More are on the way soon, i've been pressed for time so the rest will come shortly. Some of the various adjustments are adding lighting to overly dark areas, improving/adding shadows, as well as improved FPS for a smooth enjoyable experience on any machine. If you haven't launch StarBallMadNess in awhile i encourage you to come check out the new changes, As always happy gaming :)

notes.title: Level Eighteen release! 1.9.0
notes.content: 1.9.0 Brings forth a new map, (Level) Chalked full with frustration and difficulty. This fresh new level has a new feature, you must glide from platform to platform allowing fresh new ideas for levels as well as a slightly different type of difficulty. Although don't worry it only takes a few tries to get the hang of it, With level eighteen released a few performance enhancements have been made as well. Reduced some render distances to keep fps counts high, As well as adjusted some shadow bugs that occasionally caused some objects to not produce a shadow. As always happy gaming!

notes.title: 1.8.5 Map finalization
notes.content: 1.8.5 marks the completion of the seventeenth level, The new level now contains a collectable coin along with a fresh track. and of course a few minor adjustments to improve performance/gameplay, Level eighteen is underway and is expected to release late next week. If you the player would like to have some input on what level eighteen might look like please comment below before February 08.

notes.title: 1.7.3 SoundPatch & More
notes.content:
1.7.3 Brings forward a greatly required sound patch, Most of the music tracks present on a few of the maps were poorly implemented causing the volume to be quite loud. In addition the tracks have been reworked and sound much better. we're likely to see new tracks flowing into starballmadness soon, On a side note check out this video. (Link below) Map seventeen is underway no solid release date at this time though. The Eleventh map is now much easier to navigate post update you couldn't see some plats in front of you making it to difficult. 

[previewyoutube=DpNt1WgCOYU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 1.7.0 Map release!
notes.content:
1.7.0 marks the release of map sixteenth, I dearly hope you enjoy it this map is very difficult to complete.
Along with map sixteenths release are usual bug fixes improving gameplay for instance one bug no longer present in the seventh map was potentially falling right through the finish line (happened rarely) Plans for the next map are underway if you have any suggestions please feel free to comment happy gaming!

notes.title: 1.6.2 General update
notes.content:
1.6.2 introduces analytics to StarBallMadNess, It will greatly assist in improving maps that may be to difficult or to easy, With that being said achievements are in the process and will be available in the next few updates. A few maps have been tweaked along with some minor bug fixes. 

MapNine - Tweaked the lighting allowing the player to see a little better in the dark otherwise occasionally players would lose track of ball (reduced difficulty) - Fixed textures before finish line (Minor tearing)

MapSix - At the start of the map a physics issue was presented its now resolved

MapThirteenth - Improved performance cleaned up entity's creating a heavier load

notes.title: 1.6.0 Is now live!
notes.content:
1.6.0 contains bug fixes for map fifteen (ChristmasDLC) as well as general optimization for smoother gameplay, Map sixteen is around the corner! as well as achievements & general progression states.

notes.title: 1.5.8 Level tweaks and enhancements!
notes.content:
1.5.8 Level tweaks and enhancements is now live. This update aims to vastly improve players experience in early stages of StarBallMadNess. Ive come to realize the game starts out very difficult, I understand this could be displeasing quickly. Various changes/tweaks for each map will be listed below.
(No specifics for challenge purpose)
[list]
Level = 1
[*]Just before the finish line, the narrow path is now closer to the rotating platform
[*]Lengthened the landing after the small jump.

Level = 4
[*]Tweaked the new mini course just before finish line to be a bit wider as it was extremely difficult.

Level = 8 
[*]Shortened the start jump 
[*]slightly decreased the speed for the spinning platforms

Level = 14
[*] You can no longer get stuck under the elevator after it goes up if you may decide to role inside the now empty space (PS) the elevator is not suppose to come back down you miss it.. you missed it (:
[/list]
Level 13 is under some review and thought it may be subject to relatively significant change as always for the better!
 
The new map is on its way you can access a small teaser by hitting 1 key on your keyboard!
